scope: MEAS: independent numerical, report/source, published note/bar-map, actual-sheet and visual review; not aural review.

report.finding: Revised report agrees with complete-source extraction: 359 canonical events / 344 distinct pitch-onsets, 474 performed notes / five written voices, 33 occurrences / 129 quarters and 25 printed bars on one page. Five genuine legacy omissions, 15 coincident unisons and seven grace-clock movements are distinguished. Two fitting constraints and restored repeat signs remain explicitly documented.

barMap.finding: All 474 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG/index identities are pickup 0 and 1–24. The complete public page was inspected: repeat starts after the pickup and ends after bar 8; bar-22 fermata and final cadence survive. Formal seconds labels can precede full-bar downbeats because their melodic pickups lie in the previous bar; no unresolved structured pointers occur.

overlays.finding: All fifteen fresh complete-voice overlays inspected; no gross pitch/order mismatch identified. Late C5/A5 rises precede bar-22 held harmony in the correct order. q117/q117.5 constraints are fitting evidence, not independent validation. Final F2/A3/F4 attack remains 193.146047 s; its written hold to estimated 200.92 s decay end is not a measured key release.

version.finding: Complete piano No. 7: pickup, first eight full bars repeated, later return written out; exact traversal 0–8 / 1–24. Actual repeat marks and complete source voices agree; no gross cut/arrangement mismatch identified.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the symbolic-source edition is not identified as Betts’s physical performing copy.

resolvedFindings.finding: The complete named-voice extraction preserves main C5/q31 after its same-pitch grace, melody G4/q42 and D5/q58/q88.5 against held unisons, and the second A3 grace near q21.942708 tied onward. Overlapping holds survive, not hand-inserted replacement attacks. Fifteen coincident unisons and seven small renderer grace-clock shifts are separately classified. Only the skip-only repeat-control lane changes for engraving; actual public repeat signs now match the performed order.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. Passing constrained timing gates does not establish correct conversion of legacy engraving directives or physical note releases.
